HELLOSPIRE-OLD_IRON.title: Old Iron
HELLOSPIRE-OLD_IRON.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Load[/gold] 3 [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-OLD_IRON.flavor: Older than the road it walks. It has never once misfired, and never once been clean.
HELLOSPIRE-TRUE_IRON.title: True Iron
HELLOSPIRE-TRUE_IRON.description:
At the start of each combat, fill all 6 chambers with [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold].
[gold]Lead Rounds[/gold] deal 1 additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-TRUE_IRON.flavor: Whatever it was made from, it was not iron.
HELLOSPIRE-OILED_RAG.title: Oiled Rag
HELLOSPIRE-OILED_RAG.description: The first time each combat you [gold]Load[/gold], also [gold]Load[/gold] 1 [gold]Lead Round[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-OILED_RAG.flavor: Black with use, and worth more than the coat it lives in.
HELLOSPIRE-TIN_BADGE.title: Tin Badge
HELLOSPIRE-TIN_BADGE.description: The first time each turn you apply [gold]Weak[/gold], gain 3 [gold]Block[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-TIN_BADGE.flavor: Nobody ever asked to see the paperwork.
HELLOSPIRE-SPARE_SPEEDLOADER.title: Spare Speedloader
HELLOSPIRE-SPARE_SPEEDLOADER.description: The first time each combat the [gold]Cylinder[/gold] becomes completely empty, [gold]Load[/gold] 3 [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-SPARE_SPEEDLOADER.flavor: For the moment you learn how you count.
HELLOSPIRE-LONGCOAT_PLATES.title: Longcoat Plates
HELLOSPIRE-LONGCOAT_PLATES.flavor: Sewn in one winter, and never taken out again.
HELLOSPIRE-LUCKY_COIN.title: Lucky Coin
HELLOSPIRE-LUCKY_COIN.description: The first time each turn you [gold]Spin[/gold]: if the current chamber is loaded, draw 1 card; if empty, gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-LUCKY_COIN.flavor: It has come up the right way every time so far. That is what worries them.
HELLOSPIRE-ENGRAVED_HAMMER.title: Engraved Hammer
HELLOSPIRE-ENGRAVED_HAMMER.description: The first Round you successfully [gold]Fire[/gold] each turn deals 4 additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-ENGRAVED_HAMMER.flavor: Six names down the side. Room for more.
HELLOSPIRE-IVORY_HANDLE.title: Ivory Handle
HELLOSPIRE-IVORY_HANDLE.description: Rounds other than [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold] deal 3 additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-IVORY_HANDLE.flavor: Expensive, impractical, and it sits in the hand like it was grown there.
HELLOSPIRE-PORTABLE_ALEMBIC.title: Portable Alembic
HELLOSPIRE-PORTABLE_ALEMBIC.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Brew[/gold] a random Common Combat Potion.
HELLOSPIRE-PORTABLE_ALEMBIC.flavor: It has survived three lab fires. The labs did not.
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_FERVOR.title: Holy Fervor
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_FERVOR.description: Whenever you play a card that heals, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. Once per turn.
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_FERVOR.flavor: Every wound closed is a promise kept, and promises are heavy things to swing.
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_BOOK.title: Holy Book
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_BOOK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Seal of Light[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_BOOK.flavor: Every page says the same thing. It has never once been wrong.
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_SYMBOL.title: Holy Symbol
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_SYMBOL.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Spirit}[/blue] [gold]Spirit[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_SYMBOL.flavor: Worn smooth by a thumb that has never once let go of it.
HELLOSPIRE-LIBRAM_OF_WRATH.title: Libram of Wrath
HELLOSPIRE-LIBRAM_OF_WRATH.description: At the start of each turn, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold]. You can no longer gain [gold]Spirit[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-LIBRAM_OF_WRATH.flavor: The pages that preach mercy have been torn out.
HELLOSPIRE-CHAINED_GAUNTLET.title: Chained Gauntlet
HELLOSPIRE-CHAINED_GAUNTLET.description: At the start of each turn, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold]. Your [gold]Seals[/gold] no longer trigger passively.
HELLOSPIRE-CHAINED_GAUNTLET.flavor: Bound tight enough, a fist becomes a hammer.
HELLOSPIRE-CORK_STOPPER.title: Cork Stopper
HELLOSPIRE-CORK_STOPPER.description: The first Potion you use each combat, draw 1 card.
HELLOSPIRE-CERAMIC_RETORT.title: Ceramic Retort
HELLOSPIRE-CERAMIC_RETORT.description: The first time you [gold]Brew[/gold] each turn, gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-ASSAYERS_LENS.title: Assayer's Lens
HELLOSPIRE-ASSAYERS_LENS.description: The first time you gain [gold]Gold[/gold] each combat, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-ASSAYERS_LENS.flavor: Seeing the value clearly is halfway to spending it.
HELLOSPIRE-GOLDEN_CRUCIBLE.title: Golden Crucible
HELLOSPIRE-GOLDEN_CRUCIBLE.description: Whenever a card grants you [gold]Gold[/gold] in combat, gain 3 additional [gold]Gold[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-GOLDEN_CRUCIBLE.flavor: It turns a profit on everything, including itself.
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMISTS_LEDGER.title: Alchemist's Ledger
HELLOSPIRE-ALCHEMISTS_LEDGER.flavor: Every conversion is entered twice: once in ink, once in glass.
HELLOSPIRE-SANGUINE_CIRCUIT.title: Sanguine Circuit
HELLOSPIRE-SANGUINE_CIRCUIT.flavor: The body remembers what it paid for.
HELLOSPIRE-GILDED_LEDGER.title: Gilded Ledger
HELLOSPIRE-GILDED_LEDGER.description: [gold]Invest[/gold] costs are reduced by 2 [gold]Gold[/gold], minimum 1. Merchant prices are 10% higher.
HELLOSPIRE-GILDED_LEDGER.flavor: Wholesale rates for the trade. Retail for everyone else.
